mutations.name: any plan rpc failure falls back to the plan store
kills: shadow tick plan read a network failure on plan.* does not fall back: the lane fails closed and the tick exits 69

mutations.name: withheld lanes are judged like any other
kills: shadow tick owner-only lanes a lane whose initiative active-work withholds from agents writes one refused row and reads none of its tasks
shadow tick owner-only lanes an initiative missing its verdict, as from an older daemon, is refused and none of its tasks is read

mutations.name: an unread inventory reads as showing every lane
mutations.find: if ("unread" in agentLanes) return unreadRow(base, `active-work inventory: ${agentLanes.unread}`);
kills: shadow tick owner-only lanes an unread inventory fails every lane closed and exits unavailable
